messages.subject: knitr report download witout references
parts:
Hi All, 

The problem concerns the following part of code within downloadHandler. If I use in Report.Rnw an external reference database refer.bib (... \bibliography{refer}) then it does not work.
I believe it concerns the temporary directory, where there is no refer.bib.

Help much appreciated.

Robert



   output$download_report <-
        downloadHandler(filename = 'Report.pdf',
                                                
                        content = function(file){
                          
                          rnw <- normalizePath('Report.Rnw')
                          owd <- setwd(tempdir())
                          on.exit(setwd(owd))

                            out = knit2pdf(rnw, clean=TRUE)
                            file.rename(out, file)
                        },
                        contentType = "application/pdf"
                        )
